subject: Proposal sketch: three-tier usage bands & preliminary invoice
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex@zenilabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal sketch: three-tier usage bands & preliminary invoice

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Below is a short recap and a preliminary cost sketch so your finance team can start internal sizing. I attached a working workbook (zenilabs_pricing_model_v1.xlsx) and a read-only Google Sheet link for collaboration.

Quick discovery recap
- Primary use case: customer-facing summarization + internal knowledge Q&A (mixed prompt/output ratios).
- Expected steady-state volume: ~15M tokens/month with seasonal spikes to 30M in Q4.
- Latency target: sub-500ms 95th for short prompts (critical for UI responsiveness).

Preliminary pricing assumptions (sketch)
- Usage bands: 0-5M, 5-20M, 20M+ tokens (monthly buckets).
- Unit economics target (your ask): target $/1M tokens = $95 as a benchmark; we modeled three scenarios around $85 / $95 / $110 per 1M tokens.
- Estimated monthly cost (baseline 15M tokens):
  - $85/1M -> $1,275/month
  - $95/1M -> $1,425/month
  - $110/1M -> $1,650/month

Options to include in a formal estimate (what we can show in the workbook)
1) Hosted API — usage-based monthly with tiered volume discounts. Fastest onboarding.
2) Dedicated (reserved) — committed throughput with lower $/1M at higher commitment; we’ll show 6/12 month pricing slices.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — list pricing + infra support; higher TCO but required for certain compliance regimes.

Requested next steps
- Can you confirm which pricing scenario you want us to shape (low/mid/high)?
- Please add any missing monthly volume guidance for internal apps.
- If finance wants, we can produce a one-page invoice-style estimate and a short comparison table (Hosted vs Dedicated).

Attachments: zenilabs_pricing_model_v1.xlsx (working), Google Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/zenilabs-pricing-model

Thanks — I loop Jonas here for SRE/latency sizing and Marissa for formal quoting.

— Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Li <alex@zenilabs.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance <finance@zenilabs.com>, contracts@zenilabs.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal sketch: three-tier usage bands & preliminary invoice

Rafael — appreciate the clear breakouts. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Volume confirmation: the 15M/month is realistic for Q3. We expect linear growth to ~25–30M/month in 6–9 months if the pilot goes well.
2) Target $/1M: our finance team suggested a target of no more than $90/1M for the host option, but we’re open to seeing both Hosted and Dedicated comparisons.
3) SLA & latency: our product team will require a 99th percentile SLA target for short-form prompts; could you call out latency tiers in the formal estimate?

Action items on our side: I’ll forward your workbook to Finance and Contracts. If you can send a one-page invoice-style estimate with both (a) a Hosted usage band table and (b) a 12-month Reserved slice with committed token bands, that’ll help procurement.

Also, can you include payment terms (Net30 vs Net45), and if there are any upfront fees for Dedicated setup?

I copied contracts@zenilabs.com since they may want to review the canary/fallback language you mentioned on the call.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Li
Director of Product | Zenilabs
alex@zenilabs.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Li <alex@zenilabs.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Proposal sketch: three-tier usage bands & preliminary invoice

Marissa, Jonas — forwarding the thread and Alex’s ask. Please see quick internal notes below before we produce a formal estimate:

Internal notes
- Primary ask: one-page invoice-style estimate (Hosted tiered table) + a 12-month Reserved (Dedicated) option with committed discount lines. Make sure we show the blended $/1M under each option.
- Finance target: $90/1M for Hosted (try mid scenario close to $90; show $82/$90/$105 for Low/Mid/High).
- Latency: Jonas, confirm whether sub-500ms 95th and 99th SLA tiers map to our existing nodes; if Dedicated is chosen, what uplift in throughput/cost do we need to show?
- Payment terms: include Net30 standard, Net45 as an optional concession for the pilot; note that Dedicated requires a minimum 3-month commit for discounted bands.

Attachments for deliverable: update zenilabs_pricing_model_v1.xlsx with the three price bands and produce a one-page PDF summary (redwood_estimate_summary.pdf).

Timeline: can we get a first-pass estimate tomorrow morning PT? Alex is pushing procurement review next week.

Thanks — Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Li <alex@zenilabs.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Proposal sketch: three-tier usage bands & preliminary invoice (Estimate attached)

Alex / team — attaching a concise one-page estimate (redwood_estimate_summary.pdf) and an updated workbook. Highlights:

Summary (baseline 15M tokens)- Hosted (usage-based, tiered):
  Low: $82/1M -> $1,230/mo
  Mid: $90/1M -> $1,350/mo (recommended, meets Zenilabs target)
  High: $105/1M -> $1,575/mo
- Dedicated (12-month reserved commit):
  12M committed/month equivalent -> effective $/1M = $68 (requires 3-month min commit)
  24M committed/month equivalent -> effective $/1M = $55 (best-for-scale)

Other terms- Payment: Net30 standard; Net45 available for pilot with an early-payment credit tradeoff.
- Onboarding/setup: Hosted has immediate onboarding; Dedicated has a one-week provisioning lead time + optional provisioning fee (one-time) that we’ve called out in the workbook.
- SLA: We included two latency tiers in the appendix and highlighted the nodes that meet sub-500ms 95th. For Dedicated, we can guarantee a 99th percentile SLA as an addendum.

Next steps
1) Alex — pick the scenario you want pulsed into the PO: Hosted (mid) or Dedicated (12m slice).
2) If Dedicated, confirm committed band and preferred term (3/6/12 months).
3) Contracts — if you want a draft MSA/addendum, we’ll route a redline-friendly packet.

Attachments: redwood_estimate_summary.pdf, zenilabs_pricing_model_v1.xlsx (updated)

Thanks — Marissa Cole
